Default type-aware value rendering: JSON-looking strings get the JSON tree, other strings a plain code block, hashes a key/value list, lists/sets an indexed list and zsets a member/score list. Hosts override per key family via CacheNodeAdapter.renderDetail.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/cache-browser/CacheValue.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CacheValue } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
